_comment: Projects for tests/screenshots.js. Each becomes assets/work/<file>: the live site's above-the-fold view framed in a browser window. bg = page background, glow = colored light at the top (match the project's brand). enabled: false keeps an entry without capturing it by default (--only <id> still runs it). Optional: label (URL pill text, defaults to the domain), width (desktop viewport width, default 1440; height follows at 16:10), wait (extra settle ms), hide (CSS selectors to hide before capturing).
